usage.costBasis: CLI-reported list-price estimate (total_cost_usd), cumulative per session; not provider-billed
usage.finalMessage:
I added `quote <customer> <amount>`, which uses the payment-terms decision now in force (DEC-B12, 21 days) and is listed in `help` right after `invoice`; all 7 tests pass and it's committed.
The `invoice` command still uses the old, superseded 30-day terms, so a quote and an invoice issued the same day give different dates. I left `invoice` alone because changing it is outside this task and an existing test checks the 30 days.
Whether invoices should move to 21 days is an open question in `.work/report.json` for Finance/Sales Operations to decide.
OUTCOME: completed
